text:
maria nguyen: quick smoke check for cust "Velvet" LoRA merge — noticed potential behavioral regressions on summarization set after int4 quant pack. Sharing quick-eval results.
sam bailey: seen the diff? numbers?
maria nguyen: baseline (cust-finetune-v1, fp16) summaries -> avg ROUGE-L 0.62; merged lora + int4 -> 0.54 on same seed subset. hallucination rate up ~6%.
kai chen: ouch. which model artifact are we running? path?
maria nguyen: models/velvet/merged-lora-v2-int4 ; eval command:
```
rwd-eval --pack velvet-quick --seed 42 --model models/velvet/merged-lora-v2-int4 --quant int4 --metrics rouge,factuality,perplexity
```
jen-ops: did you run with KV-cache warmstart? cold vs warm can affect summaries.
maria nguyen: ran both; warmstart helps latency but not the quality gap. warm vs cold diff <1% ROUGE.
kai chen: can you push the eval logs + sample failures to the shared drive? I'll triage tokenizer/merge mismatch.
maria nguyen: uploaded gs://rwd-uploads/velvet/3723456789_evals.tar.gz — includes prompt set + top-5 outputs.
sam bailey: looks like tokenizer tokenization shift on possessives; maybe LoRA assumed different tokenizer preproc.
maria nguyen: I tried running with original tokenizer config from customer (byte-level bpe) — quality improved ~2% but still lower than baseline.
kai chen: next steps: 1) run quick ablation with float16 merged lora (no quant) 2) run int4 with per-channel quant vs symmetric 3) sanity-check tokenizer merges. I'll take 1 & 2.
jen-ops: I'll spin up a dedicated eval job on dedicated GPU pool, will tag results with velvet-lora-smoke/3723456789.
eval-bot: Started job rwd-eval-3723456792 on dedicated-pool-3.
maria nguyen: thanks all. tagging @cust-eng for visibility :eyes:.
sam bailey: maybe add a prompt subset focusing on instruction style—customer reported odd terse completions.
kai chen: noted. I'll also try merging with delta-adapter (not full lora) to see if adapter stitching helps.
maria nguyen: adding checklist to thread -> TODO: compare fp16 merged, int8 fallback, tokenizer remap, sample-by-sample diffs. planning a follow-up in 24h.
jen-ops: acked. will keep logs.
